name: Russia, mobile whitelist mode
notes: The default-deny mode switched on for mobile networks in some regions and hours: only allowed networks (and allowed SNI on their own addresses) work. The lab server is not on the list, so a tunnel to it fails; add 10.77.2.0/24 to cidrs to model a server on an allowed Russian cloud network (#650). The real lists are not public; community-maintained ones exist.

hypotheses.label: An allowed SNI counts only on the allowed domain's own addresses
hypotheses.note: #516, 2025-10-05: 'no matter what SNI you spoof, it won't connect to your own server ... it's an IP whitelist'. Off: an allowed SNI opens any address.

rules.name: Whitelist: TCP handshakes complete, but no data reaches servers off the list; UDP and ICMP to them dropped
rules.source: net4people/bbs #516 (2025-09): 'curl hangs on client hello (TCP syn is actually delivered remotely but not client hello)', ICMP to off-list addresses empty, 'it's an IP whitelist'; #650 (2026-08): default-deny with CIDR+SNI on MTS LTE. https://github.com/net4people/bbs/issues/516
